subject: Acadia Systems — supplier registry enrollment & PO routing confirmation
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acadia-sys.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acadia-sys.com
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier registry enrollment - Acadia Systems (documents attached)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. I’m sending over Acadia Systems’ supplier enrollment packet so we can get set up in your system and receive POs. Attached: the completed vendor intake form, an updated W-9, and our corporate resolution showing authorized signers.

A few items for your team to confirm:
- Legal entity name on file (we use "Acadia Systems, Inc.")
- Tax ID on the W-9 is EIN 12-3456789
- Remit-to address: 120 Harbor Lane, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101
- Preferred invoice receipt: ap@acadia-sys.com
- Bank/ACH info will be provided after vendor record activation (security reasons)

Can you confirm the PO-to-invoice binding rules (do you require PO number on the invoice) and the expected ERP/vendor ID we’ll be assigned? We have a tight cutover with one of your teams and want to avoid payment delays.

Thanks — I’ve attached the PDFs here.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Director, Strategic Procurement
Acadia Systems

Attachments: acadia_vendor_form.pdf (application/pdf), W9_Acadia_123456789.pdf (application/pdf), acadia_corp_resolution.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acadia-sys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registry enrollment - Acadia Systems (documents attached)

Hi Maria — thanks for sending this over and for the clear packet.

We received the three attachments and I’ve looped in Kimberly from AP and Karthik on Vendor Master so they can complete the vendor record and map PO routing. Quick answers below and a couple of small asks so we can finalize: 

- Legal name: we will register it as exactly "Acadia Systems, Inc." as shown on the corporate resolution.
- Tax ID: noted and will be stored as provided.
- Remit-to: we usually capture both a primary remit address and an invoice email—ap@acadia-sys.com is good.
- PO requirements: Our policy requires the Redwood PO number on invoices for straight-through processing; exceptions can be handled but may delay payment.

Could you confirm: do invoices sometimes arrive without PO numbers? If so we’ll enable a temporary manual match rule for the first 60 days for this account. Also, please confirm the name and title of the authorized signer who will sign the vendor agreement DocuSign we’ll send.

Kimberly — can you provision Acadia in Workday/ERP and create the initial vendor record (legal name + remit email), then assign a provisional vendor ID so the procurement ticket can reference it? Karthik — once AP confirms, please add the vendor to the PO routing list for the Product Partnerships team (region: us-west).

I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link for the vendor terms after we have the signer name.

Best,
Laura
Sr. Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registry enrollment - Acadia Systems (documents attached)

Hi all — I’ve kicked off vendor provisioning in Workday. Notes: 

- Provisional vendor ID: V-2028-ACD-087 (will be used for internal PO binding while legal verification completes)
- ERP mapping: set to Product Partnerships (AP route = shared-payables@redwoodinference.com)
- Invoice requirement: PO number required for automatic payment. If invoice arrives without PO we’ll route to manual queue; recommend including PO on all invoices to avoid hold.

Maria — please confirm the authorized signer name so I can attach the wiring authorization template (we only accept ACH after a signed vendor agreement and a completed bank verification). Once signed we’ll set ACH as an allowed payment method and provide the secure portal for banking docs.

I’ve attached a short checklist for final activation steps in case it’s helpful: vendor_activation_checklist.pdf (internal).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
